notes: Runtime & Memory §78 implementation machinery is substantially present.

Normative rule execution and milestone qualification remain independently subject to their applicable evidence requirements.

The existing 11-entry runtime READY implementation trace is distinct from this normative inventory. Applicability, implementation mappings and qualification dispositions remain to be reconciled before IR authority and M0 closure.

Its numerical implementation projection is published and independently reproducible. Normative LIM-* mapping, authoritative ELM adoption, applicability and formal qualification remain outstanding.

M0-BLOCK-LR progress: nine M0 production MOT capacities now have stable proposed canonical LIM-MEM identities, exact NASM-resolved runtime mappings and verified numerical values. Full normative LR schema, applicability and authoritative adoption are still outstanding.
